summary: SLO flagging: update routing scripts and analytics pipeline for new support SLO buckets
description: Issue summary: Support operations have introduced three new SLO buckets for internal SLA measurement (P0-P2 incident routing windows). The support routing scripts (route-decider) and the analytics ingestion pipeline (support-metrics-collector) are not yet aligned to emit the new SLO labels, resulting in missing SLO flags in internal dashboards and automated runbooks. Impact: On-call and triage tooling continue to show legacy SLO groupings which causes incorrect escalation windows and missing automated snoozes for long-running support work. This increases cognitive load for L2/L3 engineers and delays time-to-first-action. Scope: Affects routing decisions and SLO reporting for internal-support issues created after 2026-03-04 in prod us-east. Not customer-facing directly but affects SLA metering and internal paging. Goal: Update routing scripts to apply new slo_bucket tags at creation time, instrument analytics pipeline to accept and persist slo_bucket, and add nightly backfill job for issues created since 2026-03-04.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a new internal-support ticket with priority P1 in prod us-east using the internal-support UI or API. 2) Observe ticket metadata in routing-engine logs: the slo_bucket field is absent or set to legacy value. 3) Check support-metrics-collector ingestion logs: no datapoint recorded for slo_bucket dimension. 4) Open Support SLO dashboard: ticket count by slo_bucket does not reflect recent issues.
logs_and_artifacts: route-decider logs: s3://redwood-logs/routing/2026/03/11/route-decider-us-east.log.gz (matches missing slo_bucket for events 11:00-13:00 UTC). Analytics ingestion error trace: support-metrics-collector stderr (k8s pod collector-7d9f) referencing schema mismatch for field 'slo_bucket' (schema_v3 -> expected). Example event id: evt-0a9f3b2c. Query used for dashboard: SELECT count(*) FROM support_events WHERE slo_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY slo_bucket.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: schema rollout for support-metrics-collector (v3) was deployed on 2026-03-04 but route-decider remained on v2 tagging. Confirmed by correlating deploy tags: route-decider image: support/route-decider:2026-02-28 (no slo_bucket field), support-metrics-collector image: support/metrics-collector:2026-03-03 (schema_v3). Secondary finding: routing-engine template library contains conditional that wrote 'slo' instead of 'slo_bucket' for internal tickets created via API shortcut. Affected code paths: quick-create API and the webhook handler for infra alerts.
workaround: Manual enrichment: run the enrichment script tools/enrich-slo-bucket.py against affected tickets (backfill). For new events, an ad-hoc K8s sidecar can emit slo_bucket as a temporary shim (patch applied to support-api deployment). Both are temporary and operationally heavy.
proposed_fix: 1) Patch route-decider to include slo_bucket mapping and release v2026-03-15. 2) Update routing templates used by quick-create API to set slo_bucket correctly. 3) Add compatibility layer in support-metrics-collector to accept both 'slo' and 'slo_bucket' keys for one release window. 4) Implement nightly backfill job (lambda or k8s CronJob) to reprocess tickets since 2026-03-04. 5) Add unit and e2e tests to pipeline for schema evolution.
rollout_plan: - Stage: patch route-decider in staging and run integration tests (2026-03-12). - Canary: deploy to 10% of prod us-east traffic and validate slo_bucket presence in logs (2026-03-15). - Full rollout: 2026-03-16 after 24h canary validation. - Deploy compatibility patch to metrics-collector in parallel. - Enable nightly backfill during low-traffic window (03:00 UTC) on 2026-03-17.
rollback_plan: If new tagging causes unexpected routing churn: revert route-decider to previous image and disable quick-create changes. Compatibility in metrics-collector ensures dashboards remain stable. Backfill job is idempotent and safe to abort.
remaining_risks: - Risk of mismatched tags causing duplicate escalations if route-decider and escalation service interpret tags differently. - Backfill may produce spike in metrics ingestion; we must throttle writes and monitor ingestion lag. - Potentially missed tickets created before 2026-03-04 if older schema variants exist.
follow_up_tasks: 1) Add integration test that simulates hot-path quick-create API and verifies slo_bucket propagation. 2) Update runbooks to reference new SLO buckets and update paging windows. 3) Schedule a post-deploy audit of SLO counts versus backlog (endpoint: /support/slo-audit). 4) Retro note to internal-support on lessons learned.
